card.name: The warning against household spoons
card.fires_on: The word 'use' (or 'a') right after 'never' or 'do not' in warnings against measuring liquid doses with household teaspoons or tablespoons. A few unrelated linking words in general text also fire it.

modes.label: Household spoon warning
modes.description: The verb 'use' or 'a' after 'never' or 'do not', just before 'household teaspoons or tablespoons'.
modes.example: and to never<< use>> household teaspoons or tablespoons to measure a dose

modes.label: Scattered web text
modes.description: Linking words or commas in general prose, such as 'of' after 'outside' or a comma in a list of islands.
modes.example: to Kilimanjaro airport outside<< of>> Arusha to await deportation.
